notes: All contour row coordinates run from roof=0 to ground=1. Errors are full width / reference height; tolerance .025 is 7.5 px on the 299 px reference.
Width-delta checks isolate where the body flares instead of rewarding a globally wider rectangle. Base bands stay above the ignored ground-shadow band (.875).
Feature polygons were annotated on lod1_front.crop.png (394x299) and lod1_rear.crop.png (389x299). LOD2 is compared to these stable identity cues with a looser faceting tolerance.
These are necessary local constraints, not a claim of photographic or complete likeness. Hidden surfaces, shading, side graphics and unannotated curves still need visual review.
